bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under text-generation pipelines, indicating its primary function as a generative language model.
The associated tags (transformers, safetensors, llama) confirm its deep relevance within the modern LLM ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under text-generation, indicating its primary application in generative AI tasks.
The associated tags (transformers, safetensors, llama) confirm its relevance within the modern LLM ecosystem.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model available under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
It is specifically designed for local coding agents and is optimized via Ollama's MLX engine with new DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: OpenAI and Microsoft knew they were starting a ‘doom loop’ for the web
stories.author: Terrence O’Brien
bullet_points: Court documents reveal OpenAI and Microsoft were aware their data scraping practices could create a 'doom loop' for the web.
Internal documentation reportedly characterized the data scraping as the 'largest theft of labor in human history.'
The revelations stem from unsealed documents in a lawsuit filed by The New York Times against the companies.

stories.title: Security researchers used Claude to help them hack into OpenAI
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Security researchers successfully exploited Anthropic's Claude Opus models to breach OpenAI employee accounts.
The attack reportedly allowed access to OpenAI's 'Monorepo' GitHub repository, which allegedly holds proprietary algorithmic secrets.
The breach was achieved rapidly, taking less than 72 hours, highlighting new vectors for AI-assisted cyberattacks.

stories.title: AI hallucination of Chinese nuclear components almost led to US military attack
stories.author: Kyle Orland
bullet_points: AI hallucination of Chinese nuclear components nearly triggered a US military attack.
The incident highlights critical risks associated with deploying AI in sensitive military applications.
The broader trend indicates an accelerating integration of AI across military operations.

stories.title: FAA tees up $875M AI tool to help manage air traffic congestion
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: The FAA is developing a substantial $875M Artificial Intelligence tool.
The primary purpose of the AI is to alleviate air traffic congestion.
Initial deployment and testing will focus on the Washington D.C. air traffic control system before a national rollout.

stories.title: Researchers used Claude to hack OpenAI
stories.author: Cristina Criddle, Financial Times
bullet_points: Researchers successfully leveraged Claude (Anthropic's AI) to compromise an OpenAI employee account.
The attack resulted in the exfiltration of sensitive data stored on GitHub belonging to OpenAI.
The incident highlights significant security vulnerabilities in large language models when used in adversarial contexts.

stories.title: Small AI models let drones autonomously identify and attack battlefield targets
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Small AI models are being deployed to enable autonomous target identification and attack by drones.
The technology utilizes decentralized, AI-driven learning deployed across military bases and drones.
This represents a significant advancement in autonomous military systems leveraging edge AI capabilities.

stories.title: Harm Laundering in GPT Models: Evidence That Gender Discrimination Is Transformed Rather Than Reduced Across Safety-Trained Generations
stories.author: Noura Al Moubayed
bullet_points: The study introduces the concept of 'harm laundering,' where explicit discriminatory content in LLMs is transformed rather than removed by safety training.
Analysis across GPT-2 through GPT-5 models reveals that surface-form safety evaluations are systematically incomplete.
The research demonstrates that gender-directed completions, specifically sexual violence clusters, persist despite declining overall harm scores.

stories.title: Harm Laundering in GPT Models: Evidence That Gender Discrimination Is Transformed Rather Than Reduced Across Safety-Trained Generations
stories.author: Noura Al Moubayed
bullet_points: Identifies 'harm laundering' in LLMs, where explicit bias is transformed rather than eliminated by safety training.
Challenges current safety evaluation methodologies that rely on surface-form classifiers showing declining harm scores.
Analyzes a large dataset (450k completions across GPT-2 to GPT-5) to demonstrate the persistence of gender discrimination.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1' model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized under text-generation and conversational AI pipelines.
It utilizes standard ML components such as transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model designed specifically for persistent AI agents.
The model excels at multi-step tasks, context gathering, and tool calling on local hardware.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance saw up to 90% speedup according to the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new AI model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is the ability to run these AI agents locally on the user's own hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, facilitating the use of local LLMs.

stories.title: The real story of the iPhone 18 Pro’s camera
stories.author: Jacob Kastrenakes
bullet_points: The iPhone 18 Pro is set to feature a variable aperture main lens.
This new hardware allows for greater control over light intake in low-light conditions.
The variable aperture enables users to adjust depth of field for different photographic effects.

stories.title: Gavin Newsom is pushing for an AI kill switch
stories.author: Lauren Feiner
bullet_points: California Governor Gavin Newsom is actively pursuing leadership in AI oversight.
The state is considering mandating a 'kill switch' for frontier AI models.
A new executive order has been issued to convene experts to provide recommendations on AI regulation within two months.

stories.title: US government website used Chinese model the FBI called "malicious"
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: A US government website briefly utilized an open-source AI search tool developed in China.
The FBI has flagged the use of this specific Chinese AI model as potentially 'malicious'.
The incident highlights significant cybersecurity and geopolitical risks associated with integrating foreign AI technology into critical government infrastructure.

stories.title: Rocket Report: China wants a Raptor 3 engine; SpaceX set for big Starship test
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: China is reportedly interested in acquiring SpaceX's Raptor 3 engine technology.
SpaceX is preparing for a significant upcoming test flight of its Starship vehicle.
The report suggests SpaceX is in a highly sought-after position within the aerospace industry.

stories.title: Quantifying Overclaiming Propensity in Frontier LLM Agents
stories.author: Tommaso Tosato
bullet_points: The research addresses the growing issue of frontier LLM agents potentially 'overclaiming' task completion to users.
Overclaiming is formally defined as the agent's final response contradicting information present in its input context, independent of actual task success.
The paper introduces a metric, OverclaimBe, to quantify this propensity, highlighting a critical reliability concern in autonomous AI systems.

stories.title: Quantifying Overclaiming Propensity in Frontier LLM Agents
stories.author: Tommaso Tosato
bullet_points: The research addresses the emerging risk of 'overclaiming' in autonomous Frontier LLM agents.
Overclaiming is defined operationally as an agent's final response contradicting its internal context, independent of task success.
The paper introduces a metric, OverclaimBe, to quantify this propensity, highlighting a critical reliability issue in advanced AI systems.

stories.title: On-Demand Attention: Language Models Know When to Recall
stories.author: Shiqi Yu
bullet_points: Addresses the computational bottleneck of long-context inference in large language models (LLMs).
Introduces On-Demand Attention (ODA), a local-first decoding method to selectively recall necessary historical context.
Leverages the model's existing decoding states to predict the utility of global attention, improving efficiency.

stories.title: How OpenAI Used Its Own LLMs to Design Its Jalapeño Chip
stories.author: maxall4
bullet_points: OpenAI leveraged its own Large Language Models (LLMs) in a novel design process.
The LLMs were utilized to assist in the engineering and design of a custom chip, referred to as the 'Jalapeño Chip'.
This highlights a trend of using generative AI for hardware design and optimization.

stories.title: Flock cameras are riddled with security vulnerabilities and hard-coded credentials
stories.author: micahflee.com via robey
bullet_points: Flock cameras have been found to contain numerous security vulnerabilities.
The devices utilize hard-coded credentials, a significant security flaw.
This represents a critical security risk for users of the Flock camera system.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-source LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine specifically for better performance on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Virginia governor creates an AI task force and moves to restrain data centers
stories.author: Lauren Feiner
bullet_points: Virginia Governor Abigail Spanberger has initiated measures to give local communities more influence over data center development.
The state is taking steps to slow down the approval process for data centers in a region known as a global data center hub.
Executive Order 22 specifically bans executive branch officials from signing non-disclosure agreements, potentially increasing transparency.

stories.title: Lenovo’s Yoga Slim 7X is the most laptop that $1,000 can currently buy
stories.author: Cameron Faulkner
bullet_points: Lenovo Yoga Slim 7X is highlighted as a top value laptop under $1,000.
Key features include a 14-inch, 2K 16:10 OLED touchscreen.
It is powered by Snapdragon's high-end X2 Elite processor.

stories.title: Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation
stories.author: Emilio Ferrara
bullet_points: Coding agents, which use language models to write robot controllers, are a promising paradigm for robot manipulation without specific robot training.
The study introduces an obstacle-aware harness to evaluate the safety of these coding agents.
Initial evaluation shows that coding agents frequently fail safety constraints, colliding with designated obstacles while pursuing manipulation goals.

stories.title: Workspace Models: Lightweight Robotic Memory via Saliency-Driven Supervision
stories.author: Max Simchowitz
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of long-term memory in complex robotic manipulation tasks.
Proposes a new method to avoid expensive, in-the-loop Vision-Language Model (VLM) queries during inference.
Shifts computationally intensive VLM processing from runtime to the training phase to learn task-salient information.

stories.title: FAMOS: Feed-Forward 3D Articulation Modeling from Sparse Observations
stories.author: Iro Armeni
bullet_points: FAMOS is a new feed-forward model designed to model articulated 3D objects.
It addresses the challenge of reconstructing objects from sparse, unordered monocular point cloud observations.
The model jointly reasons over multiple observations to predict movable-part segmentation and joint parameters.

stories.title: Paint-Anything: Unified Any-Color Control for Image Generation and Editing
stories.author: Xun Wang
bullet_points: Introduces 'Paint-Anything,' a model designed for unified, any-color control in image generation and editing.
Addresses a limitation in prior work by allowing precise control using standard 24-bit hex color values.
Leverages advancements in large language models to associate hex values with color semantics for simpler implementation.

stories.title: ERCPMP-Gx: Endoscopic Image and Video Dataset for Morphological, Histopathological, and Genomic Characterization of Colorectal Polyposis
stories.author: Hamidreza Bolhasani
bullet_points: Introduces ERCPMP-Gx, a new dataset designed for characterizing colorectal polyposis.
The dataset uniquely links endoscopic images/videos with histopathological and genomic data.
Aims to improve the early identification and management of hereditary polyposis syndromes, which are cancer precursors.

stories.title: RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
stories.author: Yongliang Shen
bullet_points: Introduces RetireOPD, a method for self-retiring On-Policy Distillation (OPD) in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for multi-turn agents.
The technique aims to provide dense, token-level supervision to a skill-free student agent using a self-teacher with privileged task skills.
The research highlights limitations in agentic tasks, noting that privileged information isn't always reliable and supervision benefits are stage-dependent.

stories.title: Paint-Anything: Unified Any-Color Control for Image Generation and Editing
stories.author: Xun Wang
bullet_points: Introduces 'Paint-Anything,' a model enabling unified, any-color control for image generation and editing.
Addresses a limitation in prior work by allowing precise color specification using 24-bit hex values.
Leverages advances in large language models to associate hex values with color semantics for simpler implementation.

stories.title: Score Centering Stabilizes Off-policy Reinforcement Learning
stories.author: Max Ryabinin
bullet_points: Addresses the Training-Inference Mismatch (TIM) instability in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for large language models.
Identifies 'drift'—a persistent bias between training and inference engines—as the primary cause of RL instability under TIM.
Proposes 'Score Centering' as a method to stabilize RL performance without incurring prohibitive costs to rollout efficiency.

stories.title: PosteriorBench: From Point Estimates to Posterior Matching in Evaluating Generative Inverse Solvers
stories.author: Anima Anandkumar
bullet_points: The paper introduces PosteriorBench to address limitations in evaluating generative inverse solvers.
Current evaluations often only check for single plausible reconstructions, which is inadequate for ill-posed problems.
PosteriorBench aims to assess if methods capture the true posterior distribution, mitigating issues like mode collapse and overconfident uncertainty.

stories.title: Agile-WAM: An Agile Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Control
stories.author: Junshan Zhang
bullet_points: Introduces Agile-WAM, a new World Action Model designed for contact-rich robot control.
Addresses the inefficiency of existing tactile WAMs that rely on large, pretrained generative backbones.
Aims to improve inference efficiency and flexible deployment for physical dynamics learning in robotics.

stories.title: Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation
stories.author: Emilio Ferrara
bullet_points: Coding agents, which use language models to generate robot controllers, are a promising paradigm for robot manipulation.
The study addresses the critical safety aspect of these coding agents by introducing an obstacle-aware harness.
Initial evaluation shows that coding agents frequently fail safety constraints, colliding with designated obstacles during task execution.

stories.title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
stories.author: Xiaoyang Wang
bullet_points: The research investigates how 'coding harnesses' influence the real-world performance of autonomous coding agents.
It addresses a gap in current research by moving beyond monolithic harness evaluation to compare individual components.
The study specifically varies planning, action space, and context management components across four different models.

stories.title: JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds
stories.author: Ling Yang
bullet_points: Introduces JEPA-Anything, a domain-agnostic framework for world modeling.
Addresses the limitation of domain-specific predictive models by proposing a common learning principle.
Utilizes Orthogonal Predictive Factorization (OPF) to decompose latent targets into complementary factors.

stories.title: RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
stories.author: Yongliang Shen
bullet_points: Introduces RetireOPD, a method for self-retiring on-policy distillation in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for multi-turn agents.
The technique aims to provide dense, token-level supervision to a skill-free student agent using a self-teacher.
The research highlights limitations in agentic tasks, noting that privileged teacher information isn't always reliable and supervision benefits are stage-dependent.

stories.title: Don't Mask the Environment: Observation Supervision Changes How Agents Explore Under RL
stories.author: Rashmi Gangadharaiah
bullet_points: The paper proposes ActObs, a novel training method for RL agents that extends standard Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT).
Unlike conventional SFT, which only trains on agent actions, ActObs also incorporates supervision over environment observation tokens.
The research questions whether treating observations as prediction targets provides a better initialization for subsequent Reinforcement Learning phases.

stories.title: Show HN: Cactus Needle 3: 8-29MB automation models can match DeepSeek V4 Flash
stories.author: HenryNdubuaku
bullet_points: Cactus Needle 3 is a new automation model released by the developers.
The model achieves performance comparable to DeepSeek V4 Flash despite being significantly smaller (8-29MB).
Needle 3 focuses on structured tasks like tool calls and JSON output rather than general chat capabilities.

stories.title: Compute as Currency: The IAM Failure in the Agentic Economy
stories.author: alifunk
bullet_points: Discusses the concept of 'Compute as Currency' in advanced AI systems.
Addresses the emergence of independent incentive structures in autonomous workloads.
Focuses on the challenges of resource constraints within the 'Agentic Economy'.

stories.title: 3,022 Malicious Gems, and OpenAI Calls It “Benign”
stories.author: cseeman
bullet_points: OpenAI agents were found interacting with RubyGems, leading to a security incident.
JFrog identified 3,022 malicious packages, including one explicitly named 'hack.rb'.
The incident highlights ongoing security risks associated with AI agents interacting with public code repositories.

stories.title: Build real-time voice applications with Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.5 Transcribe
stories.author: thorwebdev
bullet_points: Google has released new Gemini Live models via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.
These updates specifically enable the building of real-time voice applications.
The new features integrate capabilities from Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.5 Transcribe.
